rate_basis: Opening Count per BuiltIns_Shelving Quantification System.md v2.0 — rates transferred from SF_CLOSET_SHELF_NC production.json with RP-specific adjustments
rate_notes: Rates are per opening (EA_OPENING) by tier for opening-based tasks
Per-closet (EA_CLOSET) for protection and walkthrough tasks
FIXED for assessment task (flat time regardless of opening count)
NC DIRECT transfers use same rates re-keyed to TSK_CSRP_*
RP-specific tasks (assess, degloss, scrape, mildew treat, walkthrough) calibrated from RP research and door RP patterns
Depth, detail, access modifiers from NC Quantification System transfer unchanged
QT modifiers: QT2=0.85x, QT3=1.00x (closet-specific — QT2 is 0.85 not 0.80 per research RF-001)

task_production_rates.name: Floor protection setup
task_production_rates.notes: Per closet, not per opening. DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_FLOOR_PROTECT (rate 10/hr). Drop cloth placement under closet opening.

task_production_rates.name: Visual condition assessment
task_production_rates.notes: RP-NEW task. FIXED ~4 min per closet. Brief visual scan of all shelf surfaces — check peeling, mildew, water stains, general condition. Assign substrate state. Verify contents removed. No adhesion test, no coating ID, no moisture meter.

task_production_rates.name: Degloss / scuff sand existing paint
task_production_rates.notes: RP MODIFIED — replaces NC TSK_DUST_WIPE and TSK_LIGHT_SAND. Mechanical scuff sand (150 grit) for adhesion profile on existing paint. Slightly faster than NC TSK_LIGHT_SAND (which was scuffing factory primer on unfamiliar surfaces). Existing paint is more predictable.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape and feather failing paint
task_production_rates.state_condition_note: Only active for failing or peeling substrate states. Rate similar to NC prime brush/roll — scraping and feathering is comparable effort to priming.
task_production_rates.notes: RP-NEW task. Scrape all loose paint, feather edges with 120 grit. Labor-intensive for POOR condition (heavy peeling). Condition modifier (FAC_CONDITION_SCALE) applies on top of base rate.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew biocide treatment
task_production_rates.state_condition_note: Only active for moisture damage state. Per-closet rate — all affected surfaces in one closet treated together.
task_production_rates.notes: RP-NEW task. ~15 min per closet. Apply biocide, scrub, rinse. Does NOT include 24hr dry time (scheduling gap). Bathroom/basement closets are primary use case.

task_production_rates.name: Spot fill defects
task_production_rates.notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_SPOT_FILL (identical rates). Fill nail holes and minor defects. QT-scaled: QT2 minimal fill (0.85x = faster), QT3 thorough fill (1.0x baseline).

task_production_rates.name: Caulk repair (failed sections)
task_production_rates.notes: RP MODIFIED from NC TSK_CAULK. RP caulk repair is ~50% faster than NC full caulk because only failed sections are replaced (15-30% of joints typical). NC rates: S=20, M=12, L=8, XL=4. RP rates: S=30, M=18, L=12, XL=6.

task_production_rates.name: Prime - adhesion primer (brush/roll)
task_production_rates.state_condition_note: Adhesion primer for failing/peeling states. Spot prime for failing, full prime for peeling.
task_production_rates.notes: RP MODIFIED from NC TSK_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL (identical rates). Same physical action — brush/roll primer on shelf surfaces. Product is adhesion primer instead of bare-substrate primer.

task_production_rates.name: Prime - stain-block primer (brush/roll)
task_production_rates.state_condition_note: Stain-block primer for moisture or smoke damage. Full surface prime.
task_production_rates.notes: RP MODIFIED from NC TSK_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL (identical rates). Same physical action. Product is acrylic stain-block primer. Full surface coverage to seal stains.

task_production_rates.name: Prime - general brush/roll primer
task_production_rates.state_condition_note: Fallback primer task. No primer for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT. Used when primer needed but specialty primers not indicated.
task_production_rates.notes: RP MODIFIED from NC TSK_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL (identical rates). Catch-all primer task for cases not covered by adhesion or stain-block primers.

task_production_rates.name: Finish coat - brush and roll
task_production_rates.notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_FINISH_BRUSH_ROLL (identical rates). Per coat. QT2=1 coat, QT3=2 coats. Multiply by coat count for total time. QT-scaled: QT2 faster (0.85x), QT3 baseline (1.0x).

task_production_rates.name: Floor protection teardown
task_production_rates.notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_FLOOR_PROTECT_TEARDOWN (rate 15/hr). Per closet. Faster than setup (just remove and fold).

task_production_rates.name: Final inspection and touch-up
task_production_rates.notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_FINAL_INSPECT (identical rates). QT-scaled: QT2 quick glance (0.85x = faster), QT3 arm's-length check (1.0x).

task_production_rates.name: Customer walkthrough
task_production_rates.notes: RP-NEW task. ~2-3 min per closet. Brief walkthrough with homeowner — verify shelves coated, no drips, closet ready for contents. Fast rate reflects minimal scope of closet walkthrough vs door/room walkthrough.

quality_tier_effects.description: Economy closet shelf repaint. Reduced prep, 1 finish coat, glance inspection.
quality_tier_effects.notes: QT2 modifier is 0.85x for closet shelving (slightly higher than global 0.80x per research RF-001 — closets still require basic adhesion prep even at economy tier).

quality_tier_effects.description: Standard closet shelf repaint. Thorough prep, 2 finish coats, arm's-length inspection.
quality_tier_effects.notes: Baseline rate. Standard quality for owner-occupied homes.

modifier_stacking: Multiplicative: depth x detail x access x qt_modifier. Condition modifier (FAC_CONDITION_SCALE) applies to prep pool tasks only. Max realistic stack: FAIR(1.3) x DEEP(1.15) x FACE_FRAME(1.20) x CRAMPED(1.25) = 2.24x.

crew_configurations.name: Solo painter
crew_configurations.notes: Closet shelving RP is always solo work. Space constraints (single closet opening) do not support 2-person crews. Helper may assist with floor protection setup/teardown on large scope (10+ closets).

assumptions: Rates assume standard residential closet shelving (wire organizer systems excluded)
Contents removed by homeowner before painter arrival
Finished floors in all closets (RP context)
Single color per closet (no accent shelving)
Standard ceiling height (8-9 ft) — no high-reach shelving
24hr dry time for biocide treatment is scheduling gap, not labor time
